bounce.name: Bounce

appearance.body: Medium build, warm orange fur with subtle tabby markings
appearance.eyes: Large vivid green eyes, highly expressive
appearance.clothing: Grey zip-up hoodie, headphones around neck, grey joggers and trainers

bounce.voice_profile: Warm, youthful British-Nigerian male. Friendly and conversational. Confident but not corporate. Slightly cheeky. Clear pronunciation of BootHop.
bounce.dalle_prompt_prefix: 3D animated Pixar-quality film style, original character, orange anthropomorphic cat named Bounce, large vivid green eyes, warm orange tabby fur, white muzzle with short whiskers, very expressive emotive face, humanoid posture, premium cinema render, NOT resembling Garfield, Tom, or any copyrighted character

dash.name: Dash

appearance.body: Fluffy, orange — same breed as Bounce but stockier build
appearance.eyes: Large green eyes with dark aviator sunglasses in some scenes

dash.voice_profile: Warm British voice. Slightly cautious and expressive. Distinctly different from Bounce. Family-friendly and natural.
dash.dalle_prompt_prefix: 3D animated Pixar-quality film style, original character, fluffy orange anthropomorphic cat named Dash, large green eyes, white muzzle and whiskers, teal travel backpack, premium cinema render, NOT resembling Garfield, Tom, or any copyrighted character

rules.consistency: Do not change faces, colours, proportions, clothing or accessories between episodes
rules.originality: Must not resemble Garfield, Tom, or any other copyrighted character
rules.references: Use bounce_ref.png in every image or video generation prompt to anchor character appearance
rules.branding: Do not generate text or the BootHop logo inside AI-created scenes — add during final editing
rules.logo: Use only the official supplied BootHop logo. Never redraw, reinterpret or misspell it.
